source: User-approved cumulative requirements in HC-64 DSP, GBrain, particle simulation, production IDE and platformer thread

policy.interface: Existing production UI is a functional example, not a layout, visual design or bypass-logic constraint
policy.native: Reuse functional repository capabilities and inherited contracts; replace obsolete UI wiring and unnecessary bypass paths without bypassing VM81 authority
policy.exact_kernel: No authoritative floating point; DSP uses explicit Float64 boundary; canonical state admission through existing signed VM81 / Hash72 / Hash216 and receipt/replay services
policy.artifact: Standalone exported artifacts contain a portable lightweight VM81 runtime and applicable Lane 5 code where contractually required
policy.non_destructive: Preserve native services and frozen layers while replacing obsolete public navigation and presentation

workspaces.name: Professional IDE
requirements: Unified editable multi-file project tree, code editor, compiler/interpreter, debug and terminal/task controls
Real installable dependencies, build logs, restartable jobs, validation and execution receipts
Project persistence, import, build, preview, export and reopen, including large-file and ZIP64-capable paths
Consistent integrated navigation; design/layout may be replaced completely

workspaces.name: HC-64 deterministic audio production
requirements: Actual integrated native C++20 DSP/VST3 source and browser-compatible Float64 DSP boundary; not a standalone promotional HTML demo
Local MP3/WAV/FLAC/OGG decoding with Float64 worker processing and upcast after browser decoder; sample-rate choices source/44100/48000/88200/96000
439 Hz reference and selectable 440 Hz comparison, shared dyadic clock
Three rails M=(L+R)/2, LateralL=L-M, LateralR=R-M; phase-coherent 4-band LR4 processing
Sub harmonics 2/3/4, phase/resonance lock, midrange 300–2500 Hz isochronic ducking 4–40 Hz and 0 to -6 dB, upper-band cubic Hermite delay 0–2 ms and asymmetry
Four-band resonance/noise processing, expansion/cancel settings and wet/dry bus from uploaded extended web prototype
Continuous floor estimation, calibrated sub-dither reconstruction blend, peak ceiling and no-NaN/Inf/denormal checks
Synchronized sample-aligned dry/wet playback with click-free crossfade, A/B keyboard interaction, optional loudness match and retained playhead
Stereo, mono-collapse and low-volume headphone monitors; loop, play/pause, scrubbing; live spectrum, transient scope, phase correlation, dry/wet RMS, crest, noise-floor and true-peak audit
Offline IEEE-754 Float64 stereo WAV export with RIFF/fmt/fact/data, strict byte sizes, SHA-256 output digest and non-clipping ceiling verification
VST3 and standalone native build/export for supported JUCE hosts; automation/state persistence and plugin delay compensation
acceptance: A/B switching audibly changes between synchronized real paths without playback restart
Every visible parameter directly affects processing or is explicitly disabled with explanation
Export format validated by binary tests and DAW import; peak ceiling independently checked; source/sample-rate compatibility tested

workspaces.name: Neural network particle simulation
requirements: Preserve original 10,368 particle projections and original working simulation, rather than replace with a separate renderer
Real physics particle updates continue independently of render rate; preserve motion continuity and smooth overlapped phase/gradient transitions
Editable particle/neural/physics parameters, inspectable graph, audio bridge, project save/replay/export
Inherit common features across simulation versions and do not reduce existing capabilities
acceptance: Live interactive physics—not static or prerecorded imagery
Continuous simulation behavior under lower render frame rates
Standalone export with portable embedded runtime when required

workspaces.name: GBrain-inspired knowledge and neural harness
requirements: Integrated model/agent harness with source provenance, knowledge hydration and retrieval; preserve external proposal versus native admission boundary
Retain all four core source roles: mathematical course Modules 0–189; ParticleSimulation.html; Pantheon complete manuscript; AGENTS.md
Retain Module194 HNAN local-symmetry artifact as additive source
Arbitrary-length resumable authenticated staged-source ingestion with exact-byte identity, source replay and SQL custody
Native Lane 5 hydration graph, typed UQCEL candidates, current parent Hash216 witness, signed environmental VM81 admission and replay
Functional neural knowledge browsing, provenance, references, user interactions and IDE integration without invented execution results
acceptance: Exact source readback/replay proven and all missing source paths explicitly reported
Signed canonical admission and Hash72/Hash216 provenance reported open until independently executed and verified

workspaces.name: Platformer Game Studio
requirements: Replace Storybook Reel as PRIMARY game-development navigation/application; preserve inherited storybook rendering services if shared
Open complete playable platformer immediately rather than scripted image/reel
Editable world/levels, player physics, enemies, hazards, collectibles, checkpoints, camera and sprite/texture controls
Provide keyboard, touch, pointer controls, restart/pause/victory/lose states and deterministic replay
Compile/build/preview/export deployable full game with project files and receipt validation
acceptance: Browser playtest reaches victory with no runtime errors
Editing a gameplay parameter visibly changes running game
ZIP/exported project runs independently and reopens correctly

workspaces.name: Native graphics and multimodal workspace
requirements: Interactive graphics/shader scene and independent renderer/runtime
Working audio/video/document/graphics ingestion and actual outputs, not placeholder panels
Connect native sprite, particle, game and DSP assets through shared project execution

production_gates: Current branch base/main and open PR dependency conflicts inventoried before merge
Dependency scoped tests, frozen-layer preservation and source hash integrity pass
Signed VM81 authority, exact Lane 5 hydration, native ABI and receipts/replay checked
Frontend controls verified against actual backend/native execution; no optimistic fake state
DigitalOcean systemd/backend/frontend paths, public HTTPS, import/export, WebAudio and browser tests validated on deployed exact SHA
No production promotion without independently verified gates and rollback/restart checkpoint
notes: This contract records requested behavior, not acceptance evidence.
PR #914 remains one component of cumulative effort; PR #915 independent harness mergeability checklist must be reconciled, not silently overwritten.
Backend audio/VM81 integer PCM transport is separate from requested Float64 IEEE mastering export.
